verdict.rationale: Superpowers is largely made of agent-oriented documentation. Its SKILL.md files are 'process documentation' written for agents and shared verbatim across harnesses. Community reports also say the Codex/OpenCode install works by telling the agent to fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md, which is literally pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt, and a probe for a .md docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a documented agent-readable docs endpoint, and first-party documentation of the fetch-INSTALL.md flow.
